gen-gf-oxanium-fs-bespoke-sans: Oldenburg looks like a sign painter's single brush stroke, with a very shallow lowercase and curves that stay open at their ends. Bespoke Sans follows in sharp, refined sans-serif, leaving generous gaps by the stems so a longer passage moves along easily.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee is approachable and plain-spoken, with terminals that stop well clear of the stem. Under Oxanium's big, commanding lowercase, a longer stretch of it moves along smoothly, its high mean line keeping the text tidy and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-aldrich: Aldrich has a professional, modern look, its x-height nearly touching the caps and its round letters cupped like open hands. Oxanium is the showier one, all commanding monoline lowercase.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-alexandria: Alexandria stands tall in the body, with wide open terminals and short stems above and below the lowercase. A longer passage in it feels clean and professional, never crowded.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-amiko: Amiko brings modern, neutral text, its lowercase strokes tall as a thick crayon mark and its terminals pointing outward like tongs. Make Oxanium small or Amiko large and the heading's big, distinctive lowercase loses its command over the page.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-bangla: Oxanium's strokes have the texture of neatly bent pipe cleaner, one uninterrupted line with curves that end in daylight. And Anek Bangla gives that a contemporary, approachable partner, with wide s curves and a short climb from midline to ascender.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-devanagari: Oxanium has a rounded-nib look, with no swelling at the stroke ends. Anek Devanagari sits beneath it in a modern, neutral sans, its open letter mouths and tall middle zone giving the commanding heading a roomier text to lean on.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase that rivals its capitals. Under Oxanium's constant-width arms and legs, its gaping c opening makes the pairing feel clean and approachable while the heading keeps its distinctive, commanding edge.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Oxanium never swells where a curve meets a stem, and its tall lowercase looks big. Anek Gurmukhi does the quieter job, with open-handed curves and big counters that keep the plain sans text professional and clean.
